description: What a parked run is waiting to do, plus its step log — or null if it is not waiting. READ-ONLY, and deliberately: approving or rejecting is human-only (ADR-0010), and no tool here can do it. This exists so an agent can tell a person exactly what they are being asked to decide, which is the opposite of deciding for them. Point them at the Inbox to approve.
name: get_staged_action
title: Get a run’s staged action
